event.title: First Fridays at IDA (Social)
event.description_text: Join us at Harmony House for IDA’s monthly First Fridays! A gathering space for artists, students, and community to connect, unwind, and create together. Each month, we open our doors at the Harmony House  for an evening of conversation, art-making, and chill vibes over food and drinks. Whether you’re here to meet new people, share your work, or just hang out, First Fridays are a chance to slow down and be in creative community.

event.title: OMAC First Fridays
event.description_text: Every first Friday, the Office for Military-Affiliated Communities hosts OMAC First Fridays at EVGR Pub & Beer Garden — a casual hangout for students, staff, veterans, and families. Expect friendly faces, easy conversation, and options for food and drink. Perfect for networking or simply unplugging, the event is open to all military-affiliated community members. Come by when you can and leave feeling more connected to campus life.

schema.name: DNAxAI Series: Demo Day! See It, Try It, Use It: AI Tools for Research
schema.description: Join us for a hands-on, 90-minute DNAxAI session for Leavey faculty who want to move beyond chatting with AI and start using it to produce real scholarly work. Three colleagues will share how they use AI in their own work and guide you as you try each tool yourself.    Wilson Lin will introduce Gemini Notebook for working with your own sources and Claude Code for AI-assisted coding. Sanjiv Das will show how to use quick agents to draft a paper, generate a companion website, and manage it all with VS Code and GitHub. Michele Samorani will demonstrate how to write and publish a book using VS Code, Git, Quarto, and Claude Code.    No specific technical background required. Just bring a laptop and your curiosity; lunch will be provided. You’ll leave with workflows you can use right away in your research, teaching, and writing. Please RSVP by Nov 9 so we can plan for lunch.    Before the workshop: About a week ahead, we’ll email instructions for installing VS Code and setting up GitHub. Please watch for that message and complete the setup beforehand so you can jump right into the hands-on activities.
